response.rationale: Diffuse sausage-shaped pancreas with capsule-like rim and delayed enhancement is classic for autoimmune pancreatitis; CA19-9 and PET uptake are nonspecific and can be seen in AIP. Chronic pancreatitis lacks the capsule-like rim and typically shows calcifications/atrophy.

rejected.why: Focal mass and vascular invasion typical of pancreatic cancer are absent; diffuse pancreatic involvement and capsule-like rim favor AIP.
Chronic pancreatitis usually shows calcifications, atrophy, and irregular ductal changes; the sausage-shaped enlargement and capsule-like rim are not characteristic.
